heads.title: Unsubstantiality
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes insubstantial things, arguments and states; only a few such as dreamy, airy or vacuous can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Intrinsicality
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Several (innate, inborn, ingrained, inbred, thoroughbred, incarnate) describe a person's basic nature, but many others describe qualities or processes rather than people.

heads.title: Extrinsicality
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Nearly all describe external, accidental or contingent things, with at most an odd use such as objective or outward for a person.

heads.title: Irrelation
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Some adjectives describe people (independent, arbitrary, insular, alien, foreign, outlandish, exotic), while most describe unconnected things.

heads.title: Dissimilarity
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes differences between things, though original, unique and novel can describe a person.

heads.title: Nonimitation
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Creative, inventive, original and exceptional can describe a person's gifts, while the rest describe things.

heads.title: Quantity
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: These are quantity words (some, any, a few, more or less) that describe amounts, not people.

heads.title: Smallness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mainly describes amounts and sizes; sparing, slight, limited or small can apply to a person, but most do not.

heads.title: Incoherence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describes physical looseness or separation; lax, relaxed, detached, loose and incoherent can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Decomposition
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Chemical and analytical process words that describe substances and processes, not people.

heads.title: Completeness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Many intensifiers (thorough, thorough-going, consummate, unmitigated, sheer, absolute) are routinely used of a person's nature, such as a consummate artist or unmitigated liar.

heads.title: Exclusion
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Describes inclusion and exclusion of things; exclusive is the only word that might describe a person.

heads.title: Order
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Orderly, neat, tidy, methodical, systematic and businesslike routinely describe a person's habits and conduct.

heads.title: Disorder
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Disorderly, untidy, slovenly, desultory, aimless, unmethodical and promiscuous routinely describe a person's habits and conduct.

heads.title: Arrangement
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Methodical, orderly, systematic and cut and dried can describe a person, but arranged, embattled and in battle array describe things.

heads.title: Inclusion
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Inclusion words describe things being contained or included; congener is at most a weak fit for a person.

heads.title: Conformity
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: About half (ordinary, common, typical, normal, habitual, usual, everyday, naturalized) describe a person, while the rest describe rules or things.

heads.title: Unconformity
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Lawless, wanton, aberrant, peculiar, irregular, arbitrary and informal can describe a person, though many others describe things or situations.

heads.title: Unity
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Solitary, lonely, odd, singular and unique can describe a person, but most words describe number or things.

heads.title: Synchronism
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Describes simultaneity and timing of events or things; contemporary and coeval are about time, not a person's character.

heads.title: Newness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Most adjectives describe newness of things, but green, raw and immature can describe an inexperienced person.

heads.title: Oldness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describe age or antiquity of things; only a few, like primitive or antediluvian, could loosely describe a person's outlook.

heads.title: Youth
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Several describe a person's youthful traits (callow, juvenile, green, youthful), but many only state age.

heads.title: Age
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mainly describe old age as a state, though mellow, senile and matronly can describe a person's temperament or manner.

heads.title: Adolescence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly state life stage, but mature, manly, womanly and virile describe a person's qualities.

heads.title: Permanence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describe lasting states of things; persistent and conservative can describe a person's disposition.

heads.title: Changeableness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Many describe temperament: fickle, inconstant, restless, erratic, versatile, unstable.

heads.title: Stability
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Several describe a steady character (steadfast, steady, firm, constant, balanced), though many describe things.

heads.title: Chance
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Describe events or outcomes by chance, not a person.

heads.title: Power
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Capable, able, competent and efficient can describe a person's skill, but most describe forces, arguments or things.

heads.title: Impotence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Incompetent, inept and unfit can describe a person's skill, but most describe lack of power in things or circumstances.

heads.title: Weakness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Weak, feeble, nervous and soft can describe a person's failings, though many words describe flimsy things.

heads.title: Destruction
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Describe states of destruction and ruin in things or events, with few person descriptors.

heads.title: Agency
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Describe whether something is operating or in effect; only practical or efficient loosely fit a person.

heads.title: Physical Energy
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Energetic, active and brisk describe people, but many (intense, caustic, corrosive, poignant) describe things or sensations.

heads.title: Physical Inertness
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Sluggish, passive, dull and slow can describe people, but most describe inert or lifeless things.

heads.title: Violence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Many describe a person's temper and manner: vehement, rude, brusque, waspish, impetuous, boisterous, bluff.

heads.title: Moderation
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Many describe temperament: temperate, sober, calm, gentle, reasonable, unruffled, peaceful.

heads.title: Influence
heads.class_title: Words expressing abstract relations
heads.reason: Mostly describe the spread or force of influences; dominant and influential can describe a person's standing.

heads.title: Region
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly about geographic regions; parochial and provincial can describe a narrow-minded person.

heads.title: Location
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Its adjectives mostly describe where things are placed or fixed, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Inhabitant
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Most adjectives name a person's origin or nationality (native, Irish, Welsh, naturalized), which are groups a person belongs to.

heads.title: Abode
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly describes places, but provincial, rustic and cosmopolitan can describe a person's outlook or manner.

heads.title: Littleness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mainly describes physical smallness, though petty is a character trait and the rest concern size or stature.

heads.title: Shortness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly describes physique or length, though curt can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Narrowness. Thinness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Describes width, thinness and build, which are physical looks rather than character.

heads.title: Height
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly describes height, though lofty, elevated and exalted can describe a haughty or high-minded person.

heads.title: Shallowness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly describes depth of water or things, though shallow and superficial can describe a person's shallow nature.

heads.title: Verticality
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly describes vertical position, though upright can describe a person's moral character.

heads.title: Pendency
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Describes hanging or suspended things, with no real application to a person's character.

heads.title: Exteriority
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly describes external position, though eccentric and superficial can describe a person.

heads.title: Circumjacence
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Describes surroundings and encircling things, not people.

heads.title: Sinistrality
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Left-handed is a physical trait, while sinister can describe a person's malign character.

heads.title: Straightness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly describes lines and shape, though direct and straight can describe a frank, honest person.

heads.title: Flatness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Describes flat surfaces and shapes, with no application to a person.

heads.title: Bluntness
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly describes blunt edges, though blunt, bluff and obtuse can describe a person's manner or wit.

heads.title: Opening
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly describes physical openings, though open can describe a frank, open-hearted person.

heads.title: Closure
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Describes closed, sealed or impassable things, with tight only rarely meaning a stingy person.

heads.title: Motion
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Mostly describes motion of things, though mercurial describes a volatile temperament.

heads.title: Quiescence
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Several adjectives (quiet, unruffled, sedentary, stay-at-home) describe a person, but most describe states of things.

heads.title: Impulse
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Impulsive and dynamic can describe a person's temperament, but impelling, booming and impelled describe motion or force, not people.

heads.title: Direction
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Straightforward, undeviating and unswerving can describe a person's conduct, but most entries (directed, aligned, bound for, North) describe direction or place.

heads.title: Deviation
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Devious, erratic, vagrant, discursive and rambling readily describe a person's habits or manner, alongside many purely spatial terms.

heads.title: Progression
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Progressive, and to a lesser extent advanced, describe a person's outlook, but advancing describes motion.

heads.title: Convergence
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Converging, confluent, asymptotic and similar terms describe lines, paths and flows, not people.

heads.title: Divergence
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Divergent, radiant and centrifugal describe movement apart or emission; only aberrant could loosely describe a person.

heads.title: Shortcoming
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Deficient and short describe lacks or measures; none ordinarily describes what a person is like.

heads.title: Agitation
heads.class_title: Words relating to space
heads.reason: Restless, agitated and unquiet can describe a person's prone mood, but shaking, convulsive and shambling describe motion.

heads.title: Materiality
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Impersonal, materialistic and unspiritual can describe a person's outlook, but bodily, tangible and objective describe matter.

heads.title: Levity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Airy, buoyant and volatile can describe a light-hearted or changeable temperament, but most entries describe physical lightness.

heads.title: Hardness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Stubborn, unbending, unyielding, inflexible and adamant describe a person's firm character, alongside many physical hardness terms.

heads.title: Softness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Soft-hearted, tender, pliant, tractable, malleable and yielding describe a person's disposition, alongside physical softness words.

heads.title: Elasticity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Resilient and buoyant can describe a person's temperament, but elasticity and stretchability are mostly physical.

heads.title: Tenacity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Tenacious and tough can describe a person's resolve, but most entries describe material strength and texture.

heads.title: Brittleness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Brash, weak and frail can describe a person, but brittle, crisp and splintery describe materials.

heads.title: Gaseity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Gaseous, vaporous, aerial and flatulent describe gases; airy and volatile are only stretched uses for a person.

heads.title: Dryness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Dry can describe a person's dry manner, but the rest (arid, sapless, dehydrated, rainless) describe things or climate.

heads.title: Island
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Insular can describe a narrow-minded person, but seagirt describes an island.

heads.title: Organization
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Organized can describe a person's habits, but organic and vacuolar describe matter or cell structure.

heads.title: Life
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Animated, vital, full of life and quick describe a person's temperament, but most entries concern being alive or living matter.

heads.title: Killing
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Several adjectives describe a person's disposition (murderous, blood thirsty, bloody minded, homicidal, thuggish, suicidal), but many more describe acts, events or things.

heads.title: Agriculture
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Almost all adjectives describe land, farming or places; only 'rustic' fits a person, and only weakly.

heads.title: Mankind
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Some adjectives describe a person's group or outlook (national, cosmopolitan, social, civic), but most describe general human or public matters.

heads.title: Man
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Male, masculine, manly and virile are ordinary descriptions of a man's nature and traits, forming most of the list.

heads.title: Woman
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Female, feminine, womanly, ladylike, maidenly and effeminate ordinarily describe a woman's nature and manner, forming most of the list.

heads.title: Sexuality
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Most adjectives (sensual, lusty, randy, passionate, libidinous, homosexual, gay, bisexual) describe a person's sexual temperament or orientation.

heads.title: Physical Insensibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Callous, unfeeling, thick-skinned, hardened, obtuse and dull describe a person's temperament, but comatose, paralytic, palsied and numb describe bodily states.

heads.title: Physical Pain
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: These describe a bodily state of pain, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Insipidity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Bland, insipid, vapid, wishy-washy, mild and weak can describe a person's character, but tasteless, stale and flat describe things.

heads.title: Bitterness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Bitter and acerbic can describe a person's temper, but acrid and bitterish describe tastes.

heads.title: Silence
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Silent and solemn can describe a person's manner, but the rest describe quiet sounds or places.

heads.title: Deafness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Deaf and its variants describe a physical condition of hearing, not a person's character.

heads.title: Dimness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Dimness adjectives describe light, colour and appearance of things, not a person.

heads.title: Transparency
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Transparent and serene can loosely describe a person, but the rest (pellucid, vitreous, hyaline) describe materials and light.

heads.title: Opacity
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Opacity adjectives describe murky, cloudy or opaque things and air, not a person.

heads.title: Brown
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: These are colour words describing appearance, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Vision
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: These describe the faculty of sight or sharp eyesight, which is a physical ability rather than character.

heads.title: Blindness
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Blindness adjectives describe a physical condition of sight.

heads.title: Invisibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to matter
heads.reason: Invisibility adjectives describe whether something can be seen, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Intellect

heads.reason: Brainy, cerebral, intellectual, rational and spiritual can describe a person's kind of mind, but many others describe mental operations or things.

heads.title: Absence or want of Intellect
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general
heads.reason: Most adjectives (moronic, idiotic, brainless, thoughtless, void of reason) describe a person's intellectual make-up.

heads.title: Thought
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general
heads.reason: Many adjectives (thoughtful, meditative, reflective, contemplative, studious, sedate, introspective, philosophical) describe a person's habitual cast of mind.

heads.title: Incogitancy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general
heads.reason: Several adjectives (unintellectual, unthinking, inconsiderate, mindless, vacuous) describe a person's habitual lack of thought.

heads.title: Idea
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general

heads.title: Topic
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.section: I. Operations of intellect in general
heads.reason: The adjectives describe what is in someone's mind at a given time, not what sort of person they are.

heads.title: Curiosity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives such as inquisitive, prying, snoopy and nosy describe a person's habitual character.

heads.title: Incuriosity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives such as incurious, aloof, detached and indifferent describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Attention
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Attentive, observant and alert can describe a person, but many others (rapt, transfixed, riveted) name passing states of attention.

heads.title: Inattention
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Heedless, scatter-brained, hare-brained, giddy-brained and offhand describe a person's habits of conduct and thought.

heads.title: Care
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Careful, considerate, particular, guarded and vigilant describe a person's habitual conduct and character.

heads.title: Neglect
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Negligent, careless, remiss, imprudent and unwary describe a person's habitual failings in conduct.

heads.title: Inquiry
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives mostly describe questions, matters and states of inquiry rather than people.

heads.title: Answer
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Answering, respondent and conclusive describe replies and arguments, not a person's character.

heads.title: Experiment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Experimental, provisional, tentative and untested describe methods, results and provisional states, not people.

heads.title: Comparison
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Comparative and comparable describe relations between things, not a person's character.

heads.title: Incomparability
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Incommensurable and incomparable describe things that cannot be measured against each other.

heads.title: Discrimination
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Discriminating can describe a discerning person, while distinctive and nice mostly describe things.

heads.title: Indiscrimination
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Identification
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Measurement
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe measurability and perceptibility of things, not people.

heads.title: Evidence
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe evidence and grounds for reasoning, not people.

heads.title: Counter Evidence
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe contrary or unsupported evidence and claims, not a person.

heads.title: Qualification
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its adjectives qualify statements, terms and agreements rather than describe a person.

heads.title: Possibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Possibility adjectives such as feasible, achievable and accessible describe plans and outcomes, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Impossibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Only 'visionary' could describe a person; the rest describe things, plans and events.

heads.title: Probability
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly about claims and appearances (plausible, presumable), with only 'reasonable' and perhaps 'specious' describing a person.

heads.title: Improbability
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Wild' and 'strange' can describe a person's temperament, but most adjectives describe unlikely events or ideas.

heads.title: Certainty
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Uncertainty

heads.title: Reasoning

heads.title: Intuition & Sophistry

heads.title: Demonstration
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Confutation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its adjectives describe arguments and claims that can be refuted.

heads.title: Judgment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its adjectives describe judgments and conclusions, with at most 'judging' applying to a person.

heads.title: Discovery
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Misjudgment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Most adjectives (narrow-minded, prejudiced, intolerant, dogmatic, fanatical) describe a person's habits of mind.

heads.title: Overestimation

heads.title: Underestimation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe undervalued things, with at most 'depreciating' applying to a person.

heads.title: Belief
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Many adjectives (cocksure, confident, confiding, unsuspecting, convinced) describe a person's attitude, though others describe a passing state of mind.

heads.title: Unbelief. Doubt

heads.reason: Several adjectives (skeptical, suspicious, distrustful, incredulous) describe a person, while others describe claims that are doubtful or unbelievable.

heads.title: Credulity

heads.title: Incredulity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Assent
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Dissent

heads.reason: Many adjectives describe a person's stance or affiliation: dissident, dissentient, recusant, protestant, sectarian, schismatic, heterodox, intolerant.

heads.title: Knowledge
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe a state of being aware or informed (aware of, privy to, au fait), with only a few such as knowing that fit a person's nature.

heads.title: Ignorance

heads.title: Ignoramus

heads.title: Truth

heads.title: Error

heads.title: Maxim

heads.title: Absurdity

heads.reason: Some adjectives describe a person's manner (quibbling, ridiculous, extravagant, fantastic), but most describe ideas or statements.

heads.title: Intelligence, Wisdom

heads.title: Sanity

heads.title: Memory

heads.reason: Describe a present state of recollection (remembered, retained in the memory, unforgotten), not a character.

heads.title: Oblivion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe things forgotten or past; forgetful and heedless can describe a person's habit.

heads.title: Expectation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Describe passing states of anticipation (on tenterhooks, all agog, in prospect), not enduring traits.

heads.title: Inexpectation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe passing surprise or unexpected events; unpredictable can describe a person's nature.

heads.title: Disappointment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Disappointed and aghast describe passing states, while disgruntled can name a mood a person is prone to.

heads.title: Foresight
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Foreseeing, prescient, farseeing and farsighted describe a person's judgement and habit of looking ahead.

heads.title: Prediction
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Describe predictions, omens and signs (prophetic, ominous, portentous, auspicious), not people.

heads.title: Omen
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Ill-boding' describes omens and portents, not a person.

heads.title: Oracle
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Supposition
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Supposition adjectives such as 'hypothetical', 'conjectural' and 'assumed' describe ideas and claims, not a person's character.

heads.title: Analogy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Analogical' describes reasoning or comparison, not a person.

heads.title: Imagination
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Many adjectives here describe a person's temperament or habits of thought, such as 'imaginative', 'romantic', 'flighty', 'Quixotic', 'enthusiastic' and 'fanatic'.

heads.title: Meaning
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Meaning adjectives such as 'significant', 'pithy' and 'synonymous' describe words and ideas, not people.

heads.title: Unmeaningness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Unmeaningness adjectives describe speech, writing and trivia rather than a person's nature; 'vacant' is at most a look.

heads.title: Intelligibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Intelligibility adjectives mostly describe clarity of statements, though 'plain' and 'positive' can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Unintelligibility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes unclear things, but 'inscrutable' and 'enigmatic' can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Equivocalness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Equivocal', 'ambiguous' and 'indeterminate' describe statements or situations, not a person.

heads.title: Metaphor
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Figurative-language adjectives describe speech and style, not a person's character.

heads.title: Interpretation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes explanations and translations; 'polyglot' can describe a person who speaks many languages.

heads.title: Misinterpretation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Describes wrongly understood or untranslated texts, not people.

heads.title: Interpreter
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Manifestation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: A few adjectives such as 'demonstrative' and 'arrant' can describe a person, but most describe the obviousness of things.

heads.title: Latency. Implication
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Latency adjectives describe hidden or unexpressed states of things, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Information
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Communicative', 'informed' and 'plain spoken' can describe a person, while the rest describe reports and documents.

heads.title: Correction
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Corrective' describes a remedy or action, not a person.

heads.title: Concealment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Close' and 'secret' can describe a reserved person, while most describe hidden things and concealed plans.

heads.title: Disclosure
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Open' can describe a frank, open-hearted person, but 'disclosed' describes things revealed.

heads.title: Ambush
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Camouflaged, hidden and concealed describe positions or things, not a person's character.

heads.title: Publication
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: 'Notorious' and 'arrant' can describe a person, while the rest describe published or public things.

heads.title: News
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The adjectives describe rumours, reports and the circulation of news, not a person's character.

heads.title: Secret
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives such as involved, labyrinthine, mazy and confidential describe things, not people.

heads.title: Messenger
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Affirmation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Many adjectives (positive, dogmatic, confident, decided, emphatic, solemn, formal) describe a person's manner and temperament, though others describe statements.

heads.title: Negation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Only negative, and perhaps denying, can describe a person's disposition; the rest describe statements or disputes.

heads.title: Teaching
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describes teaching and instruction; didactic can describe a person's habitual manner, but the rest do not.

heads.title: Misteaching
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Misteaching and unedifying describe instruction or examples, not people.

heads.title: Learning
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Studious, scholarly and teachable describe a person's habits and dispositions towards learning.

heads.title: Teacher
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Professorial can describe a person's manner, though it mainly relates to the teacher's role.

heads.title: Learner
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: In leading strings describes a learner's dependent state, not a lasting character.

heads.title: School
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Scholastic, academic, collegiate and educational describe schools and institutions, not people.

heads.title: Veracity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Truthful, sincere, candid, frank, honest, trustworthy, guileless and similar words describe a person's character.

heads.title: Falsehood
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Deceitful, dishonest, mendacious, disingenuous, evasive and faithless describe a person's character, alongside some words for statements.

heads.title: Deception
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Deceitful, deceptive, deceiving and insidious can describe a person, but most (sham, mock, counterfeit, spurious) describe things.

heads.title: Untruth
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Untrue, fictive, fabricated, forged and unfounded describe statements and objects rather than people.

heads.title: Dupe
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Deceiver
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Exaggeration
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Exaggerated, extravagant and preposterous describe speech, claims and things rather than a person's character.

heads.title: Indication
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Indicative, symptomatic and diagnostic describe signs and things; only demonstrative or typical loosely describe a person.

heads.title: Record
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Obliteration
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Out of print, unrecorded and leaving no trace describe records and states, not people.

heads.title: Recorder
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Representation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Represent, illustrative, imitative and iconic describe depictions and representations, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Misrepresentation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Misrepresented describes a thing that has been wrongly portrayed, not a person's character.

heads.title: Painting
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Painted, pictorial, pencil and oil describe artworks and media, not people.

heads.title: Sculpture
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its adjectives describe materials and artworks (sculptured, marble, ceramic), not people.

heads.title: Engraving
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Engraved and lapidary describe carved or inscribed objects, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Artist
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Language
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly about language itself, but bilingual and polyglot can describe a person by their linguistic group or skill.

heads.title: Letter
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Letter-related adjectives (alphabetical, syllabic, abecedarian) describe written symbols, not people.

heads.title: Word
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Word-related adjectives (verbal, nominal, derivative) describe terms and wording, not a person.

heads.title: Neologism
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Archaic and colloquial describe words or speech styles rather than what a person is like.

heads.title: Nomenclature
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Naming adjectives (named, ycleped, nuncupative) describe labels for things, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Misnomer
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Self-styled and pseudonymous describe a person's label or name status, which is only borderline as a description of the person.

heads.title: Phrase
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Expressed and idiomatic describe phrases, not people.

heads.title: Grammar
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Solecism
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Ungrammatical, solecistic and similar words describe faulty wording, not a person.

heads.title: Style
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Perspicuity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Obscurity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Obscure, crabbed and involved describe unclear writing or speech, not a person's character.

heads.title: Conciseness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe concise style, though laconic, curt and terse can describe a person's manner of speaking.

heads.title: Diffuseness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe wordy style, though verbose and long-winded can describe a person's habit of talking.

heads.title: Vigor
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe forceful style, though vigorous, spirited, lively and bold can describe a person.

heads.title: Feebleness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mixes style words (bald, jejune) with person-describing ones like feeble, languid, cold and frigid.

heads.title: Plainness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mixes style words (unvaried, chaste) with person-describing ones like plain, simple, homespun and matter-of-fact.

heads.title: Ornament
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe inflated style, though pompous and pedantic can describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Elegance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mixes style words (classical, Ciceronian) with person-describing ones like elegant, graceful, polished and unaffected.

heads.title: Inelegance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mixes style words with person-describing ones like uncouth, awkward, affected, stiff and graceless.

heads.title: Voice
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly describe the voice or speech sound; articulate and vocal are only occasionally applied to a person.

heads.title: Aphony
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its adjectives mostly describe a state of the voice or speech (dumb, voiceless, hoarse, tongue-tied) rather than what sort of person someone is.

heads.title: Speech
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mostly about speech as a medium, but outspoken, eloquent and oratorical can describe a person's habitual manner.

heads.title: Stammering
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Mainly speech defects and vocal qualities; only affected can plausibly describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Loquacity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Talkative, loquacious, garrulous, voluble, glib and flippant are habitual traits of a person's speech and conduct.

heads.title: Taciturnity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Taciturn, reserved, closetongued and sparing of words describe a person's temperament and habits of speech.

heads.title: Allocution
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Response
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Conversation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Conversing, interlocutory and colloquial describe talk and its style, not a person; discursive is at most a stretch.

heads.title: Soliloquy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Its only adjective, soliloquizing, describes an act of speaking alone, not a person's character.

heads.title: Writing
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives describe written forms and scripts (written, uncial, cuneiform), not people.

heads.title: Printing
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives describe printed matter and typesetting, not people.

heads.title: Correspondence
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: The only adjective, epistolary, describes letters and correspondence.

heads.title: Book
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties

heads.title: Description
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives describe accounts, narratives and legends rather than a person's nature.

heads.title: Dissertation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Discursive and expository describe treatises and argument, not a person.

heads.title: Compendium
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Compendious, synoptic and abridged describe summaries and works, not people.

heads.title: Poetry
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Adjectives name verse forms and styles (Sapphic, Ionic, iambic); poetic at most could describe a temperament.

heads.title: Prose
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Prosy and prosaic can describe a dull, unimaginative person, but the rest describe writing style and form.

heads.title: The Drama
heads.class_title: Words relating to the intellectual faculties
heads.reason: Theatrical, histrionic, melodramatic and stagy can describe a person's showy manner, but most describe drama as an art form.

heads.title: Will
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Willful, autocratic and spontaneous describe people's dispositions, while optional, discretional and voluntary describe actions or choices.

heads.title: Necessity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Unthinking, mechanical, blind and unconscious can describe a person's habits, while necessary, inevitable and fated describe events and things.

heads.title: Willingness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Willing, eager, earnest, forward, docile and predisposed are attitudes and dispositions a person has.

heads.title: Unwillingness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Unwilling, averse, reluctant, disinclined, laggard, remiss and scrupulous describe a person's attitudes and habits.

heads.title: Resolution
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Nearly all its adjectives (resolved, determined, strong-willed, firm, indomitable) describe a person's character and temperament.

heads.title: Perseverance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Persevering, steadfast, plodding, staunch and similar words describe a person's steady character and conduct.

heads.title: Irresolution
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Irresolute, double-minded, fickle, light-minded and vacillating are character traits of a person.

heads.title: Obstinacy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Obstinate, stubborn, pig-headed, sulky and self-willed are temperament words describing people.

heads.title: Tergiversation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Ductile, slippery as an eel, trimming and reactionary describe a person's pliant or political disposition.

heads.title: Caprice
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Capricious, eccentric, whimsical, wayward, crotchety and captious mostly describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Choice
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Eclectic is a person's habit of taste, but optional, preferential and chosen mostly describe things or groups.

heads.title: Absence of Choice
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Indifferent and uninterested describe a person's attitude, while neuter and neutral mostly do not.

heads.title: Rejection
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Rejected, reject, out of the question and to be thought of describe things or proposals, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Predetermination
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Premeditated, designed and well-laid mostly describe plans, though calculated and cunning can describe a person.

heads.title: Impulse
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Impulsive and unguarded describe a person's habit, but extemporaneous, snap and improvised describe actions.

heads.title: Habit
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Habitual could describe a person, but most words (usual, common, household, well-trodden) describe things or occurrences.

heads.title: Desuetude
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Unseasoned and untrained could describe a person's lack of experience, but most words describe things or states.

heads.title: Motive
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Persuasive, disposed, infatuated and smitten describe a person's inclinations, while most others describe things or influences.

heads.title: Absence of Motive
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Aimless and capricious describe a person's habit, while without rhyme or reason describes an action.

heads.title: Dissuasion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Dissuasive and admonitory describe acts or words, though repressed can describe a person's temperament.

heads.title: Pretext
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Alleged describes a claim, and apologetic only sometimes describes a person's manner.

heads.title: Good
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Good is a central description of a person's moral character.

heads.title: Evil
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Disastrous, awry, out of joint and disadvantageous describe events or situations, not people.

heads.title: Intention
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Intended, in view, in prospect and on the anvil describe plans or things, with only minded or intending touching a person.

heads.title: Chance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes actions and events, though 'aimless', 'unpredictable' and 'indiscriminate' can describe a person's way of being.

heads.title: Pursuit
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Pursuit adjectives describe a current state or activity, such as 'in full cry' or 'on the scent', not what someone is like.

heads.title: Avoidance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Shy' and 'evasive' describe a person's temperament, while most others describe animals, things or circumstances.

heads.title: Relinquishment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Relinquished' and 'relinquishing' describe an act of giving up, not a person's character.

heads.title: Business
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Businesslike' and perhaps 'professional' can describe a person's manner or way of life, but the rest describe affairs and things.

heads.title: Plan
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Plan adjectives describe schemes and preparations rather than a person, apart from a marginal use of 'strategic' or 'planning'.

heads.title: Method
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Mid-course
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Circuit
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Circuit adjectives describe roundabout routes or means, and only a marginal use of 'indirect' or 'backhanded' could fit a person.

heads.title: Requirement
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Requirement adjectives describe needs and demands on things and situations, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Instrumentality
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Subservient' can describe a servile person's disposition, while the rest describe roles or means.

heads.title: Means
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Instrument
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Mechanical' and 'brachial' describe instruments and devices; 'mechanical' applies to a person only in a stretched sense.

heads.title: Substitute
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Materials
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Wooden' can describe a stiff, unemotional manner in a person, while 'adobe' describes a material.

heads.title: Store
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Store adjectives describe supplies and spare items rather than a person.

heads.title: Provision
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Waste
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Wasted' describes a person's gaunt looks and 'at a low ebb' a passing condition, not character.

heads.title: Sufficiency
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Competent' describes a person's skill, while the rest describe quantities, adequacy and things.

heads.title: Insufficiency
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Insufficiency adjectives describe lack of things and circumstances such as 'ill-off' or 'short of', not a person's character.

heads.title: Redundancy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Overweening', 'extravagant', 'lavish' and 'exuberant' can describe a person's habits or temperament, but most describe excess in things.

heads.title: Importance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Importance adjectives describe the weight of events, things and matters rather than people.

heads.title: Unimportance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Indifferent' and perhaps 'common' can describe a person's attitude or class, while the rest describe things and events.

heads.title: Utility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Handy' and 'efficient' can describe a person's skill, but most adjectives describe the usefulness of things.

heads.title: Inutility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Inept' describes a person's failing in skill and 'vain' a conceited trait, while the rest describe useless things.

heads.title: Expedience
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes things and actions, though 'expedient', 'proper', 'fit' and 'seemly' can describe a person's conduct, so the head is mixed.

heads.title: Inexpedience
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives describe things or arrangements, but 'objectionable', 'improper' and 'unseemly' can describe a person's conduct.

heads.title: Goodness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Good', 'nice', 'good as gold', 'innocent', 'harmless' and 'inoffensive' readily describe what a person is like.

heads.title: Badness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Mischievous', 'malignant', 'malefic', 'pernicious' and 'mischief-making' readily describe a person's nature, though many others describe things.

heads.title: Perfection
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Perfect', 'faultless' and 'model' can describe a person, but most adjectives describe things and conditions.

heads.title: Imperfection
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The adjectives describe defective things or conditions, and none readily describes a person's nature.

heads.title: Cleanness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Pure', 'clean', 'neat' and 'tidy' can describe a person's habits or character, but most describe things that are unstained.

heads.title: Uncleanness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Slovenly', 'untidy' and 'unkempt' can describe a person's habits, but most describe dirty things and substances.

heads.title: Health
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Hardy', 'robust', 'staunch', 'brave' and 'hearty' can describe a person, but most describe physical health or states.

heads.title: Disease
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The adjectives describe passing illness or confinement, not what a person is like; 'squeamish' is the only temperament word.

heads.title: Salubrity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Wholesome' and 'benign' can describe a person, but most describe healthy things, climates and environments.

heads.title: Insalubrity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Every adjective describes harmful substances, air, places or conditions, not people.

heads.title: Improvement
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Progressive' and 'corrigible' can describe a person, but most describe improving states of things.

heads.title: Deterioration
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The entries describe decline in things and states; none describes a person's nature.

heads.title: Restoration
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Restored', 'convalescent' and 'rejuvenated' describe passing physical states or things, not a person's character.

heads.title: Relapse
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Remedy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The adjectives describe remedies and medicines; 'neurotic' is used here of drugs, not a person.

heads.title: Bane
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Safety
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The adjectives describe states of safety or circumstances such as being under cover, not a person's character.

heads.title: Danger
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Untrustworthy' and 'dangerous' can describe a person, but most describe exposed or hazardous situations.

heads.title: Refuge
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Pitfall
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Warning
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Alarm

heads.reason: The single adjective 'alarming' describes things or events, not a person.

heads.title: Preservation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes things or states of condition; only 'conservative' (an attitude) and perhaps 'preserving' suit a person.

heads.title: Escape
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Escape adjectives describe a state of getting away, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Deliverance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Saved, redeemable and rescuable describe a thing's or person's situation, not what someone is like.

heads.title: Preparation

heads.title: Nonpreparation

heads.reason: Mostly describes unfinished things, but 'raw', 'green' (inexperienced) and 'coarse' can describe a person.

heads.title: Essay
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Tentative' can describe a cautious manner, while 'empirical' and 'probationary' describe methods or status.

heads.title: Undertaking
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The sole adjective, 'undertaking', describes an enterprise, not a person.

heads.title: Use
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Used and well-worn describe the state of objects or paths.

heads.title: Disuse
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Unused, unspent and similar words describe objects, money or things not employed.

heads.title: Misuse
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The only adjective, 'misused', describes a thing treated wrongly.

heads.title: Action
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Doing, acting and on duty describe a current activity or status rather than a person's nature.

heads.title: Inaction
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Passive' is a temperament trait, but most others describe not doing or being out of work.

heads.title: Activity

heads.reason: Many adjectives (active, brisk, lively, vivacious, nimble, spirited) describe a person's temperament and habits.

heads.title: Inactivity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Lazy, indolent, slothful, idle, listless and dilatory are standard descriptions of a person's character.

heads.title: Haste
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Hasty, impetuous, hotheaded, brusque, fussy and pushing describe a person's habitual conduct and temper.

heads.title: Leisure
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Quiet, calm and deliberate can describe a temperament, but most words describe states of leisure.

heads.title: Exertion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Hard-working, painstaking, energetic and strenuous describe a person, but many others describe tasks or difficulties.

heads.title: Repose
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Relaxed' can describe a person's manner, but the rest describe a state of rest or unstrained things.

heads.title: Fatigue
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Fatigue words describe passing physical condition (tired, spent, haggard), not character.

heads.title: Refreshment
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Refreshed and refreshing describe states or effects, not a person's nature.

heads.title: Agent
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Workshop
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: These adjectives describe a person's current work situation or location (at work, at the shop), not what sort of person they are.

heads.title: Conduct
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Businesslike and practical can describe a person's manner, but the rest (strategical, executive) mostly describe activities or posts.

heads.title: Direction
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Directing and hegemonic describe leadership or dominance of things and groups more than a person's character.

heads.title: Director
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Advice
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The only adjective, recommendatory, describes a letter or statement rather than a person.

heads.title: Council
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: All the adjectives describe legislative bodies, assemblies and their functions, not people.

heads.title: Precept
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Skill

heads.reason: Skillful, adroit, expert, deft and proficient readily describe a person's competence in how they act, so most of the list applies.

heads.title: Unskillfulness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Bungling, clumsy, gauche, maladroit, inexpert and similar words describe a person's failings in handling tasks and social situations.

heads.title: Proficient

heads.title: Bungler
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Cunning
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Cunning, crafty, artful, subtle, designing and tricky are character traits and habits of conduct in people.

heads.title: Artlessness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Artless, naive, sincere, frank, candid, guileless and ingenuous describe a person's temperament and manner of dealing with others.

heads.title: Difficulty
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes tasks and situations (laborious, onerous, arduous), though a few words such as crabby or difficult to deal with describe a person.

heads.title: Facility
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mixes things that are easy to do (facile, within reach) with person-descriptors such as tractable, submissive, yielding and glib.

heads.title: Hindrance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes obstacles and circumstances (burdensome, cumbrous, waterlogged), with only obstructive or obtrusive plausibly applying to a person.

heads.title: Aid

heads.reason: Helpful, friendly, neighborly and well-disposed describe a person's disposition, while auxiliary, ancillary and accessory describe things.

heads.title: Opposition
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Hostile, antagonistic, unfriendly, cross and competitive describe a person's attitude, while adverse, inimical and opposed often describe circumstances or forces.

heads.title: Cooperation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Party

heads.title: Discord
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Quarrelsome, disputatious, factious and litigious describe a person's temperament, but most others (discordant, ajar, pettifogging) describe situations.

heads.title: Concord
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Congenial, conciliatory and harmonious can describe a person, but most of the list (concordant, cemented, in still water) describes states or relations.

heads.title: Defiance

heads.title: Attack
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Defense
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Defensive and hardened can describe a person, but most adjectives (armored, ironclad, castellated) describe things.

heads.title: Retaliation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Retaliatory is close to a habit a person might have, but the adjectives mainly describe acts of retaliation.

heads.title: Resistance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Recalcitrant, renitent and stubborn describe a person's temperament, while the rest describe resistance to things.

heads.title: Contention
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Most adjectives (belligerent, combative, pugnacious, bellicose, contentious, competitive) describe a person's disposition.

heads.title: Peace
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Peaceable, peaceful, calm, tranquil, pacific and dovish readily describe a person's temperament and attitude.

heads.title: Warfare
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Only a handful (belligerent, combative, bellicose, martial, warlike) describe a person; most describe armed states or situations.

heads.title: Pacification
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Conciliatory can describe a person's attitude, but composing and pacified describe states or things.

heads.title: Mediation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The single adjective mediatory describes an action or role, not a person's character.

heads.title: Submission
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Submissive and resigned describe a person's disposition, but most others (untenable, indefensible, undefended) describe things or situations.

heads.title: Combatant

heads.title: Arena
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Completion

heads.title: Noncompletion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The adjectives describe unfinished work or states of progress, not a person.

heads.title: Success

heads.title: Failure
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Trophy

heads.title: Prosperity

heads.title: Adversity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Mediocrity

heads.title: Authority
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Government
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Politics
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Partisan can describe a person's allegiance, but political mostly describes matters of politics.

heads.title: Laxity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Lax, loose, slack, weak, relaxed, unbridled and anarchical all readily describe a person's habits or character.

heads.title: Severity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Severe, strict, harsh, stern, dour, rigid, austere and inflexible are standard descriptions of a person's temperament.

heads.title: Lenity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Lenient, mild, gentle, tolerant, indulgent, easy-going and forbearing describe a person's disposition.

heads.title: Command
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Only 'commanding' (an imposing manner) fits a person; 'callable' does not.

heads.title: Disobedience
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Disobedient, unruly, insubordinate, incorrigible, mutinous, seditious and recalcitrant describe a person's conduct and nature.

heads.title: Obedience
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Obedient, compliant, loyal, faithful, devoted, resigned and passive describe a person's disposition.

heads.title: Compulsion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes compulsions and things; only 'peremptory' and 'forcible' can plausibly describe a person's manner.

heads.title: Master

heads.title: Servant

heads.title: Freedom
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Subjection
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Dependent, subordinate, downtrodden, henpecked and enslaved describe a person's standing and disposition, while others describe circumstances.

heads.title: Liberation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: 'Liberated' can describe a person's free-thinking attitude, but it is a single word with a narrow personal sense.

heads.title: Restraint

heads.title: Commission

heads.title: Abrogation

heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Deputy
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Acting, vice and accredited describe a role or office, not what a person is like.

heads.title: Permission
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Mostly describes what is allowed or legal; 'permissive' and 'indulgent' can describe a person's attitude, but the rest cannot.

heads.title: Prohibition
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Prohibitive, restrictive, contraband and unauthorized describe rules and things; 'exclusive' is the only plausible personal use.

heads.title: Consent
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Consenting describes a situation, and 'unconditional' and 'squeezable' do not describe a person's character.

heads.title: Offer
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Its adjectives describe offers, goods and availability (for sale, to let, on hire), with at most 'disengaged' applying to a person's free time rather than what they are like.

heads.title: Refusal
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Refusing, recusant, uncomplying, restive and unconsenting describe a person's dispositional stance, though several others are about things or outcomes.

heads.title: Request
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Suppliant, supplicant, importunate and clamorous describe a person's manner of asking, but most entries are postures or circumstances rather than traits.

heads.title: Deprecation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Deprecatory and intercessory could describe a person's manner, but the rest (deprecated, protested, unsought) describe acts or things.

heads.title: Petitioner
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Promise
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Committed, pledged and bound can describe a person's dependability, while promissory, votive, affianced and 'upon oath' describe documents or passing states.

heads.title: Release from engagement
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: The only adjective, 'absolute', describes a release, not a person.

heads.title: Compact
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Conditions
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Security

heads.title: Observance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Nonobservance
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Lawless, transgressive, evasive, elusive and violating mostly describe a person's habitual conduct and character.

heads.title: Compromise
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Acquisition
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Profitable, gainful, lucrative and similar words describe gains, pay and transactions, not a person.

heads.title: Loss
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Its adjectives describe states of loss or deprivation (bereft, out of pocket, rid of), which are circumstances rather than character.

heads.title: Possession
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Endowed with, possessed of and master of could describe a person's qualities, but most describe holdings, stock and things at hand.

heads.title: Exemption
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Devoid of could describe a person lacking a quality, but exempt, immune and without mostly describe status and things.

heads.title: Participation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Partaking can describe a person who shares in something, and communistic a political belief, but both are weak as person descriptions.

heads.title: Possessor
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Property
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Retention
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Relinquishment

heads.title: Transfer

heads.title: Receiving
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Apportionment

heads.reason: Apportioning and respective describe shares and allocations.

heads.title: Lending

heads.title: Borrowing
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers

heads.title: Taking

heads.title: Restitution
heads.class_title: Words relating to the voluntary powers
heads.reason: Restoring describes an act of restitution, not a person.

heads.title: Stealing

heads.title: Purchase

heads.title: Sale

heads.title: Wealth

heads.title: Poverty

heads.title: Credit

heads.title: Debt

heads.title: Regret

heads.title: Relief

heads.title: Aggravation

heads.title: Cheerfulness

heads.reason: Most adjectives ('cheerful', 'cheery', 'blithe', 'breezy', 'chipper', 'buoyant') describe a person's habitual disposition.

heads.title: Dejection
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Many adjectives ('melancholy', 'gloomy', 'somber', 'spiritless', 'lugubrious', 'joyless') describe a person's temperament, though others describe things or weather.

heads.title: Rejoicing
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Mostly describe momentary states of triumph or delight ('elated', 'exultant', 'jubilant'), which a person is only briefly in.

heads.title: Lamentation
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Some adjectives ('tearful', 'lachrymose', 'querulous', 'plaintive') describe a person's disposition, while others describe a passing state of mourning.

heads.title: Amusement

heads.reason: Several adjectives ('jovial', 'jolly', 'jocund', 'playful', 'roguish', 'sportive') describe a person's temperament, while others describe entertainments.

heads.title: Weariness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Wit

heads.title: Dullness

heads.title: Beauty

heads.title: Ugliness

heads.title: Ornament

heads.title: Jewelry
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Blemish

heads.title: Simplicity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Taste
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Vulgarity
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Coarse, ill-bred, underbred, ungentlemanly, unladylike and common are standard ways of describing a person's manners and nature.

heads.title: Fashion
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers
heads.reason: Genteel, well-bred, gentlemanly, ladylike, civil, polished and courtly describe a person's manners and social standing.

heads.title: Ridiculousness

heads.title: Ridicule

heads.title: Fear

heads.title: Rashness

heads.title: Desire

heads.title: Indifference

heads.title: Dislike

heads.title: Fastidiousness
heads.class_title: Words relating to the sentient and moral powers

heads.title: Satiety

heads.title: Wonder

heads.title: Expectance

heads.title: Boasting

heads.title: Celibacy
